_note: SIMULATION-ONLY ASSUMPTIONS. None of these values has been measured on an Arduino Portenta H7. They are order-of-magnitude placeholders chosen so that the relative ordering of states is plausible for an STM32H747 (Cortex-M7 @480 MHz + Cortex-M4 @240 MHz) with a camera. Replace with measured values per docs/HARDWARE_VALIDATION_PLAN.md before making any physical energy claim.

M4_IDLE.description: M4 clock-gated idle, watcher not running (always_on mode)

M4_MONITOR.description: M4 running the low-rate watcher sensing loop (includes low-resolution sensing front end)

M4_PROCESS.description: M4 computing watcher features and score

RPC_COMMUNICATION.description: M4 sending a wake/inference request over the inter-core channel

M7_WAKEUP.description: M7 leaving sleep, clocks and memories restarting

M7_INFERENCE.description: M7 running stage-1 detector inference (includes high-resolution camera capture)

M7_SECOND_PASS.description: M7 running the optional second detector pass

M7_POSTPROCESS.description: M7 decoding boxes / NMS / result packaging

M7_IDLE_AWAKE.description: M7 awake but idle (linger or always_on between frames)

_alias: Identical content to config/power_model.json (the simulator default). This file is the ASSUMED model. config/power_model_calibrated.json does not exist: it is created only by scripts/import_hardware_measurements.py from real measurement input.
